t: How to Find and Buy Your Target Audience? (CPM and CPP) | billups OOH Insights
s: In Out-of-Home advertising, we typically buy based on CPMs. CPP is more commonly broadcast-based but can be used as well. CPMs tell you the total cost of impressions, whereas CPPs tell you how heavily your advertising is saturating the market. For example, if you want to have a $10,000 budget and want to buy 100,000 impressions you could afford a CPM of $10.
